worldcombat.skill.orderup.summary: Serve a precise, non-contact strike with elegant poise: it hurts the target and shatters the Reflect, Light Screen and Aurora Veil around the strike; if a small companion is at your side, it also raises one of your stats in that companion's likeness (or shares it with nearby allies).
worldcombat.skill.orderup.use.1: Raise a stat while a small companion is at your side
worldcombat.skill.orderup.use.2: Open a fight with both a shatter and a buff
worldcombat.skill.orderup.description.0: The strike deals about %1$s non-contact damage with a %2$s block half-width; the target's Defence, type matchup and criticals are settled on impact.
worldcombat.skill.orderup.description.1: Reach %1$s blocks; Reflect, Light Screen and Aurora Veil within %2$s blocks of the strike shatter together.
worldcombat.skill.orderup.description.2: With an ally clearly smaller than you within %1$s blocks, you gain %2$s stage(s) of a stat in its likeness (solo mode adds one more), and can share the buff with allies within %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.orderup.share.on: Share mode: you and up to four nearby allies each gain 1 stage and the shatter radius is 1.2x, at 0.94x single-hit power and +8 ticks of cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.orderup.share.off: Solo mode: you gain one extra stage, 1.06x single-hit power and a shorter cooldown; the shatter covers only the base radius around the strike.
worldcombat.skill.orderup.timing: Range %1$s blocks; %2$s s preparation, %3$s s recovery, %4$s PP, %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.orderup.growth.0: From level %1$s the strike rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.orderup.growth.1: From level %1$s the strike rises to %2$s and the buff to %3$s stage(s).
worldcombat.skill.orderup.preference.sha: On: you and up to four nearby allies each gain 1 stage and the shatter radius is 1.2x, at 0.94x single-hit power and +8 ticks of cooldown. Off: solo mode, one extra stage for you at 1.06x power and a shorter cooldown.
Beyond this distance it closes in instead of serving. Larger values open the strike from further out.
Serve when a dish is at hand
On: prefer to serve while a small companion is at your side, turning it into a self-buff. Off: rank by threat and distance only.
